rationale: Archive CheckSammy from the infrastructure PortCo list. CheckSammy operates a waste-services marketplace, software platform and four material-processing hubs, but I Squared's investment is held through its venture-classified InfraTech strategy and no other disclosed investor satisfies the qualifying direct-infrastructure mandate test. Preserve the historical operating, financing, ownership and source record while removing the company from published infrastructure portfolio views.

supports: I Squared lists CheckSammy under its InfraTech strategy
I Squared defines InfraTech as a venture strategy targeting growth-stage technology companies
CheckSammy operates four ZeroPoint facilities but remains a technology-enabled waste-services company
